statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
CPT code 93247, Long-term continuous ECG monitoring study, was ordered
The service is to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to the patient's intermittent symptoms
Diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9 support the service
The denial reason code is CO-29
The denial is based on the time limit for filing having expired
The service is medically necessary to assess cardiac causes underlying the patient's syncope and transient neurological deficits
